reader.requirement: At --std 85 a successful OPEN makes the relative file's record area available, and for an EXTERNAL file connector every program of the run unit that describes the file (contained or separately written, under any record description) shares the one record area, so a MOVE, WRITE or READ in one program is seen in the others.

reader.notes: Re-read of the moved code (the probe re-run at --std 85 on this tree prints what the first read recorded). An EXTERNAL FD's FileModel is renamed into the ::EXT:: band so every describing program reaches one runtime connector (RegisterRelative returns early for an existing one), and the FD's records are external records (DataItem.HasExternalAttribute through RecordOfFile) sharing the file's record-area storage (ExternalStorageName).
